title: Adda
desc: Abhi, a professional couple-breaker, falls in love with Priya during a job. However, he must prove his genuine feelings to win her heart, overcoming her doubts and her engagement to another man.

title: Baak
desc: Shiva's search for the truth behind his estranged sister's death leads him to her mansion, where a mysterious supernatural presence lurks. Can he stop it before it consumes him?

title: Sahasam
desc: Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.

title: Sarkaru Vaari Paata
desc: Mahi tries to retrieve a large amount of money she loaned to her deceitful partner. However, she uncovers a giant banking scandal on her visit.

title: Gully Rowdy
desc: A young man tries to find a balance between his love interest and friends. Meanwhile, his friends convince him to stay rowdy.

title: Shock
desc: Sekhar and Madhurima's happily married life is ruined when he's falsely accused of being Maoist by corrupt officials. However, Geeta, a journalist, tries to prove his innocence but to no avail.

title: Anekudu
desc: Madhu, an animator, is plagued by recurring thoughts about her previous life. Her life takes a turn when she meets someone from her mysterious past.

title: Crazy
desc: Roommates J K Boss, Nagaraj and Cheenu lead an idle, debt-ridden life. However, things take a turn when they fail to deliver a package and get in trouble with a powerful gangster.

title: Aishwaraabimasthu
desc: Vasu and Saravanan are best friends since childhood. However, their friendship is put to a test when they fall in love with Seema and Aishwarya, respectively.

title: Raja Rani
desc: Two people enter an arranged marriage to please their parents, living as strangers under one roof. However, an unforeseen event prompts them to reassess their relationship and emotions.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Mad 2
desc: Laddu narrates his Goa adventure to jail visitors, where a stolen necklace, gangster Maxx and undercover cop Ashok lead to chaos, arrests and Laddu's jail time.

title: Skanda: The Attacker
desc: After Rayudu and Ranjith Reddy's children elope, the CMs turn against each other. However, when a college student kidnaps Reddy's daughter, a revenge saga unravels.
